reason: Role name has aria-invalid=true and aria-errormessage pointing to a span that is neither live nor listed in aria-describedby, so assistive technology that ignores aria-errormessage never reads the error. Chromium does expose errormessage "Please complete this field" on the textbox and the same text is visible, so users can still tell what is wrong. Optional ARIA with minor impact: low.

value.name: Role name
value.template: textbox "Role name" [invalid=true, errormessage=Please complete this field] (You have <n> characters remaining.)

reason: After Save New Role with no account ticked, "Please select at least one checking account." appears as a plain div (generic, no role, no live region, not tied to the Account access group). Focus stays on Save New Role and the toast region stays empty after 3 seconds, so a screen-reader user gets no sign that saving failed or why. 4.1.3 fails; the message can still be found by exploring the page, so medium.

Save New Role with an empty Role name shows "Please complete this field" under the field. Focus stays on the button, the error container has no live region or alert role, and the toast region stays empty, so nothing is announced on submit. The aria-errormessage link only helps once the user goes back to the field. 4.1.3 fails; medium.
